title: Database Systems Fundamentals
description: This course covers the basics of database systems, including data storage, retrieval, and management. It's designed for beginners who want to learn the fundamentals of database systems and how to work with them.

modules.title: Introduction to Databases
modules.summary: Learn the basics of databases, including what a database is and how it's different from traditional data storage.

modules.title: Setting Up a Database Management System
modules.summary: Install and configure a database management system on Windows and macOS.

modules.title: Working with Tables and Data
modules.summary: Learn how to create, modify, and insert data into tables using SQL.

modules.title: Advanced SQL Topics
modules.summary: Learn how to use joins, nested queries, and ER diagrams to work with complex data.
